name: ui-design-skill
description: Reusable UI/UX design, implementation, and review guidance based on durable human-interface principles, with Apple Human Interface Guidelines as a primary reference.

interface.shortDescription: Design and review usable, responsive interfaces.
interface.longDescription: Reusable UI/UX guidance for designing, implementing, and reviewing interfaces while preserving each product's own visual identity and platform conventions.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface for usability, hierarchy, responsiveness, and accessibility issues.
Redesign this screen while preserving the product's existing visual identity.
Improve this user-facing flow using the UI Design Skill.
